# 1523. Count Odd Numbers in an Interval Range

## Solution 1 (time O(1), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def countOdds(self, low, high):
        """
        :type low: int
        :type high: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        if low % 2 == 0:
            low += 1
        if high % 2 == 0:
            high -= 1
        return (high - low + 2) / 2
```
